# Edinburgh Live

> Edinburgh Live is a comprehensive local news and lifestyle platform covering Edinburgh and Scottish news, sports, entertainment, and community information.

Edinburgh Live serves as the primary digital news source for Edinburgh and surrounding areas including Midlothian, West Lothian, and East Lothian. The site combines breaking news coverage with lifestyle content, sports reporting on local football clubs (Hearts and Hibernian), entertainment guides, and practical travel and traffic updates for the region.

## Key Topics

- Edinburgh
- Local News
- Breaking News
- Edinburgh Events
- Crime Reports
- Scottish Football
- Transfer News
- Team News
- Heart of Midlothian FC
- Hibernian FC
- What's On
- Entertainment
- Traffic and Travel
- Police Scotland
- Community Stories

## News & Breaking Stories

- [Homepage](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk): Homepage for Edinburgh Live news, sport, and entertainment content
- [News Hub](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/news): Main news hub with breaking news, live blogs from Edinburgh and UK
- [Edinburgh News](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/news/edinburgh-news): Local Edinburgh news coverage with breaking stories and community updates
- [Crime News](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/all-about/crime): Crime news and Police Scotland updates for Edinburgh and surrounding areas
- [Politics](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/all-about/politics): Edinburgh politics coverage including Scottish Parliament and elections

## Sports Coverage

- [Sport Hub](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/sport): Sports news hub with football, fixtures, results, and UK sports coverage
- [Hibernian FC](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/all-about/hibernian-fc): Hibernian FC coverage with team news, transfers, and match reports
- [Heart of Midlothian FC](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/all-about/heart-of-midlothian-fc): Heart of Midlothian FC news including transfers, fixtures, and match coverage

## Entertainment & What's On

- [Best in Edinburgh](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/best-in-edinburgh): Guide to Edinburgh's best restaurants, bars, events, and entertainment
- [What's On News](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/best-in-edinburgh/whats-on-news): Edinburgh events, things to do, contests, and entertainment listings
- [Gigs and Clubs](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/best-in-edinburgh/gigs-clubs): Edinburgh gigs, clubs, live music events, and festival announcements
- [Food and Drink](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/all-about/food-and-drink): Edinburgh restaurant reviews, dining guides, and food and drink news
- [Shopping](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/best-in-edinburgh/shopping): Shopping news, retail openings, deals, and product reviews for Edinburgh

## Practical Information

- [Traffic and Travel](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/all-about/traffic-and-travel): Traffic updates, travel news, and commute information for Edinburgh area
- [In Your Area](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/in-your-area): Directory of Edinburgh neighborhoods and local area community guides
- [Property](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/all-about/property): Edinburgh property market news, house listings, and real estate coverage
- [Jobs](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/all-about/jobs): Edinburgh employment news, job vacancies, and career advice coverage

## Lifestyle & Community

- [Family and Kids](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/all-about/family-and-kids): Family news, parenting advice, kids activities, and family events coverage
- [Stay In](https://www.edinburghlive.co.uk/all-about/stay-in): Stay-in activities, home entertainment, and lifestyle content for Edinburgh
